_about: Release gate limits for node tests/perf/measure.mjs --gate. Measured on build 8.2.12: raw 1854 KB (raw limit raised from 2,000 to 2,010 KB in 8.3.7 for the Friends card; compressed limits unchanged), brotli 470 KB, gzip 555 KB; mid-range phone first paint 260 ms, ready 3,054 ms, largest paint 3,336 ms, blocking time 442 ms. Sizes and node counts have about 8% headroom; timings about 50%, because CI machines are slower and noisier than a developer machine. Raise a limit only in a pull request that says why.
